title: प्रेस विज्ञप्ति
summary: The Nepalese government has reduced the number of ministries from 22 to 18 and is reorganizing the structure and staff of the merged and new ministries. Some employees may be excess due to the reorganization. The government will request the Public Service Commission to fill vacant positions after managing excess employees.

title: Australia Awards Scholarship - 2027 का लागि दरखास्त आह्वान हुने सम्बन्धी सूचना ।
summary: The Australian Government is offering scholarships for master's degree programs in 2027, with applications open from February 2 to April 30, 2026, targeting nine priority sectors in Nepal. The scholarships aim to support Nepal's long-term development, and applicants must meet eligibility requirements, including residence in Nepal and relevant professional experience. The Australia Awards team will provide online information sessions to support applicants.

title: Press Release- Pardon to 33 Nepali Inmates by the Government of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
summary: The Government of Saudi Arabia has granted a royal pardon to 33 Nepali inmates on the occasion of Ramadan 1447 AH. The pardon was granted following a request by the Government of Nepal through its Embassy in Riyadh. The inmates will return to Nepal after completing the due legal process.

title: माननीय परराष्ट्रमन्त्री श्री शिशिर खनालको भारत भ्रमण पश्चात त्रिभुवन अन्तर्रष्ट्रिय विमानस्थलमा आयोजित प्रेस ब्रिफिङको प्रेस नोट
summary: Foreign Minister Shishir Khana returned to Kathmandu on 7 June 2026 after an official visit to India, where he met Indian Foreign Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar and other officials. The two sides discussed trade, connectivity, energy, water resources, and people-to-people ties, and announced three joint initiatives including cross-border payments, handover of post-earthquake reconstruction projects, and a digital language translation platform MoU. The visit also included talks with India's National Security Advisor and an address at the India Foundation.

title: TERMS OF REFERENCE, AMBASSADOR OF NEPAL
summary: The Government of Nepal is seeking applications for the position of Ambassador of Nepal to various countries, with a tenure of up to four years and a deadline of June 5, 2026. The ambassador will represent Nepal's national interests and promote its foreign policy objectives. Eligible candidates must be Nepali citizens with a minimum of a bachelor's degree and experience in foreign policy or international relations.

title: प्रेस विज्ञप्ति २०८२ असोज २७ गते
summary: The Office of the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers issued a press release warning that individuals or groups are collecting donations and contributions in the name of the Prime Minister and the office. The office clarifies that no permission has been given for such fundraising and urges the public not to trust these misleading requests. Anyone encountering such activities should report them to local authorities or the PM's office, and Nepalis abroad should inform the nearest Nepali embassy.

title: Press Release- Malaysia
summary: Nepal's Minister for Foreign Affairs, Pradeep Kumar Gyawali, sent a congratulatory message to Hishammuddin bin Tun Hussein on his appointment as Malaysia's Foreign Minister. He expressed confidence that Nepal-Malaysia relations will be further strengthened during his tenure.

title: सङ्क्षिप्त सूची प्रकाशन तथा प्रस्तुतीकरण र अन्तर्वार्तासम्बन्धी सूचना
summary: Kathmandu University has published the shortlist of candidates for the Vice Chancellor position. Shortlisted candidates must give a 15-minute presentation followed by an interview on 2083/04/22 at the Ministry of Education, Singha Durbar, Kathmandu. Feedback on the candidates can be submitted via a Google link by 2083/04/20.

title: Press Release- Foreign Minister Holds Virtual Meeting with UK Defence Ministers on British Gurkha Issues
summary: Foreign Minister Shishir Khanal held a virtual meeting with UK Defence Secretary John Healey and Veterans Minister Louise Sandher-Jones to discuss long-standing British Gurkha grievances, including the demand for proportionate pensions. Khanal urged the UK to resolve these issues with justice, fairness, and respect, and the UK side reaffirmed its commitment to work closely with Nepal. Representatives of British Gurkha organisations also attended the meeting.

title: Advisory to Nepali Nationals in Israel and Iran
summary: Nepal's Ministry of Foreign Affairs has issued an advisory for Nepali nationals in Israel and Iran due to the evolving situation in the Middle East. It advises them to follow local security instructions, stay indoors, remain vigilant, and keep in touch with Nepali missions. It also recommends deferring travel to Israel or Iran until conditions stabilize and urges Nepalis in other Middle Eastern countries to stay alert.

title: प्रेस विज्ञप्ति (२०८२।१२।१८)
summary: The Ministry of Education, Science and Technology has denied rumors about weekly holidays in educational institutions, stating that such information is false and baseless. The ministry has requested all concerned parties to refrain from spreading misleading information. The ministry has also warned that legal action will be taken against those who spread false information and misuse government documents.

title: माननीय परराष्ट्र मन्त्री श्री शिशिर खनालज्यू मित्रराष्ट्र जनवादी गणतन्त्र चीनको औपचारिक भ्रमण सम्पन्न गरी स्वदेश फर्कनुहुँदा जारी गरिएको प्रेस नोट
summary: Nepalese Foreign Minister Shri Shishir Khanal has concluded his 4-day official visit to China, where he met with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi and other high-ranking officials to discuss bilateral relations and cooperation.

title: आ.व. २०८३/०८४ को पदपूर्ति सम्बन्धी वार्षिक कार्यतालिका
summary: This notice announces the annual schedule for vacancy filling (पदपूर्ति) for fiscal year 2083/084. It provides a timeline for recruitment-related processes, likely for government positions. The notice is published in Nepali and appears to be directed at job seekers and relevant authorities.

title: Collaborative Programs
summary: Kathmandu University offers collaborative programs with national and international institutions, including Bachelor and Master degrees in various fields. The programs are offered in partnership with institutions such as Lumbini Buddhist University and Indian Institute of Technology. The collaborations provide opportunities for students to study in different fields such as aviation management, yogic science, and energy technology.

title: परराष्ट्र मन्त्रालयको अपिल
summary: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has issued an appeal to Nepali nationals in West Asia, urging them to rely only on official government information and avoid spreading rumors or fear-inducing content. It warns that violating local security laws could lead to heavy fines, imprisonment, or deportation. The ministry also requests media support in spreading public awareness.

title: University News
summary: Kathmandu University has been hosting various events and conferences, including the 19th International IFIP WG 9.4 Conference and Falling Walls Lab Kathmandu 2026, to promote research, innovation, and collaboration. The university has also been visited by the Honorable Minister for Science, Technology and Innovation, Mr. Mahabir Pun, to discuss strengthening collaboration in these areas. Additionally, the university's 101st meeting was held under the chairmanship of the Minister of Education and Sports.

title: Press Release: Pardon to 111 Nepali Nationals by the Government of UAE
summary: The UAE government has pardoned 111 Nepali nationals on Eid Al Adha, allowing them to return to Nepal after completing legal procedures. The Nepali government appreciates this gesture, seeing it as a sign of deepening friendship between the two countries. The pardon was granted in response to requests from the Nepali embassy in Abu Dhabi.

title: प्रेस विज्ञप्ति (२०८२।०४।१४)
summary: Nepal's Education, Science and Technology Minister Raghu Ji Pant met with Japanese Ambassador MAEDA Toru in Kathmandu. They discussed expanding cooperation in education, information technology, scholarships, and support for Nepali students in Japan. The ambassador noted next year's 70th anniversary of Nepal-Japan ties and reaffirmed Japan's continued assistance, including rebuilding flood-damaged sections of the Sindhuli-Bardibas road.

title: Press Release on the Official Visit of the Rt. Hon. Vice President to Qatar
summary: Nepal's Vice President Ramsahay Prasad Yadav will make an official visit to Qatar from 14 to 16 July 2026 to convey condolences on the passing of the former Amir, Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani. He will deliver a letter of condolence from President Ramchandra Paudel to Qatar's Amir on 15 July and return to Kathmandu on 16 July.

title: Attention: Application for the position of Ambassador
summary: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has set up an alternate application link for the Ambassador position after applicants faced server errors due to high traffic. Those who already submitted successfully and received confirmation do not need to apply again. The official alternate link is https://mofa.gov.np/form/update-form-1/.

title: स्वत: प्रकाशन : चौथो त्रैमासिक प्रतिवेदन ,आर्थिक वर्ष २०८२/८३
summary: This is the fourth quarterly report of the Office of the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers for fiscal year 2082/83 (Baisakh–Asar 2083). It is published under the Right to Information Act and details the office's structure, staffing, major activities, and financial progress. The office has 172 permanent and 31 contract positions, organized into 9 divisions and 23 branches.

title: नेपाली राजदूतावास जर्मनीको अत्यन्त जरुरी सूचना!
summary: The Embassy of Nepal in Germany has issued an urgent notice. The notice does not specify details but is categorized under news. Recent press releases from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs include pardons for Nepali nationals by the governments of UAE and Saudi Arabia.

title: Press Release on the Tragic Death of a Nepali National in Kuwait
summary: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Nepal issued a press release expressing deep sorrow over the death of a Nepali national in an attack in northern Kuwait. It condemns the attack, urges restraint and dialogue, and calls for respect for international humanitarian law. The Ministry also offers condolences and promises to facilitate the repatriation of the deceased's remains.

title: अत्यन्त जरुरी सूचना ।
summary: The Passport Department has signed an emergency agreement with supplier IN Smart Identity France SAS to procure an additional 700,000 passports, ending the forced reduction in passport production. Daily appointment slots will be increased from 1,000, and applicants who applied by Kartik 15 will receive passports within two weeks, while those applying through foreign missions will receive them within one to two weeks.

title: School of Law
summary: Kathmandu University School of Law offers law programs and provides updates on admissions, scholarships, and events. The school aims to cultivate the next generation of legal minds. Recent updates include notice for document verification and admission for BBM-LL.B and BEc-LL.B fall intake 2026.

title: विदेशी नियोगहरुमा भिसा आवेदन गर्ने नेपालीहरुलाई अनुरोध
summary: This Nepali notice requests citizens applying for visas at foreign missions to submit only authentic documents and truthful information. It warns that false or misleading documents can lead to visa rejection, travel bans, and legal consequences, and reminds applicants that they remain responsible even when using visa consultants. It also urges compliance with destination countries' visa laws, as violations can harm both the applicant and Nepal's overall reputation.

title: Transcripts & Grades
summary: This notice explains how students and alumni of Kathmandu University can request academic transcripts, certificates, and credential verification, including sending documents directly to employers or WES. It lists fees for various documents and provides bank account details for payment.

title: Remarks By the Rt. Hon. Prime Minister Mr. KP Sharma Oli at the Announcement of Sagarmatha Sambaad
summary: Nepalese Prime Minister KP Sharma Oli announced the Sagarmatha Sambaad, a dialogue forum to address global issues, during the International Year of Glaciers' Preservation. The forum aims to provide a platform for collective contemplation and shared reflections on contemporary issues. Nepal's unique historical outlook, domestic success stories, and strategic location make it an ideal host for this initiative.

title: Travel Advisory — Iran
summary: The Nepalese government advises citizens living and working in Iran to exercise caution and follow local security advisories, and urges those planning to travel to Iran to postpone their plans until the situation normalizes. Nepali citizens can contact the Ministry of Foreign Affairs or the Embassy of Nepal in Doha for emergencies. The advisory is due to the current situation in Iran.

title: सवारी साधन तथा अन्य मालसामान सोझै वार्ताद्वारा लिलाम बिक्रि गर्नेसम्बन्धी सूचना
summary: A public notice announces the auction sale of vehicles and other goods through direct negotiation. The notice is dated 15 Falgun 2077 (Nepali calendar). Interested parties should refer to the notice for further details.

title: भौतिक पूर्वाधार पुनर्निर्माण कोष सम्बन्धी सूचना
summary: The Government of Nepal has established a fund for the reconstruction of physical infrastructure damaged during recent protests. The fund is managed by the National Reconstruction Authority and donations can be made directly to the account. The government urges individuals and organizations to be cautious of potential misuse of funds and to report any suspicious activities.

title: सूचना- विभिन्न मुलुकहरूका लागि नेपालको राजदूत पदमा आवेदन/सिफारिस आह्वान
summary: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Nepal has called for applications and nominations for the position of Ambassador to various countries. Eligible and interested Nepali citizens can apply or be nominated by others. The application process is open until June 5, 2026.

title: Statement by Hon. Mr. Pradeep Kumar Gyawali, Minister for Foreign Affairs at the High-Level Segment of the 46th Session of Human Rights Council
summary: Nepal's Foreign Minister Pradeep Kumar Gyawali addressed the UN Human Rights Council, reaffirming Nepal's commitment to human rights and highlighting progress in gender equality, women's representation, and transitional justice. He also thanked India, China, and COVAX for COVID-19 vaccine support and noted Nepal's pledge to eliminate child labor and child marriage.

title: लुटपाट भएका/चोरिएका सामान फिर्ता गरिदिने सम्बन्धमा।
summary: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs requests the public to return computers, laptops, printers, and other government and personal items that were looted or damaged during the incident at Singha Durbar on 2082/05/24. The ministry has initiated legal action against those involved and asks anyone with information about the stolen items to contact the provided officials; informants' identities will be kept confidential.

title: Remarks by Hon. Pradeep Kumar Gyawali at a seminar organized by Embassy of Israel in Kathmandu to mark the 60th Anniversary of Nepal-Israel relations
summary: Nepal's Foreign Minister delivered remarks at a seminar marking 60 years of Nepal-Israel diplomatic relations, highlighting cooperation in agriculture, labor, technology, and tourism, and recalling Israel's humanitarian aid after the 2015 earthquake. He emphasized shared democratic values and future plans to deepen bilateral ties.

title: Call for international observers to observe "House of Representatives Election, 2026" of Nepal
summary: Nepal has issued a public call inviting international observers to observe the House of Representatives Election scheduled for 2026. The notice was published on 14 Kartik 2082 (approximately 30 October 2025).

title: Press Statement issued by Ministry of Foreign Affairs on some Points Mentioned in the Joint Statement on the State Visit of Prime Minister of Nepal to India
summary: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Nepal issued a press statement clarifying certain points mentioned in the joint statement released during the Prime Minister's state visit to India. The statement is dated 2 Ashoj 2073 (around September 2016). The page also lists related press releases, including one on Nepali climbers on Broad Peak and a Nepal-Canada bilateral consultation meeting.

title: Third Meeting of the Nepal-Australia Bilateral Consultation Mechanism (BCM)
summary: The third meeting of the Nepal-Australia Bilateral Consultation Mechanism was held in Kathmandu on 24 July 2026, where both sides reviewed bilateral relations and discussed cooperation on climate resilience, green economy, water management, hydropower investment, trade, tourism, education, and people-to-people ties. The delegations, co-chaired by Nepal's Foreign Secretary and Australia's First Assistant Secretary, reaffirmed their commitment to turning shared understandings into tangible outcomes. The first Joint Nepal-Australia Trade and Investment Committee meeting under the Trade and Investment Framework Arrangement was also held in Kathmandu the previous day.

title: About Us
summary: Kathmandu University (KU) is an autonomous, not-for-profit public institution established in December 1991. It offers over 200 academic programs across seven schools and has produced more than 41,000 graduates. The university's mission is to provide quality education for leadership, and its vision is to become a world-class university.

title: सर्वसाधारणको राय माग गरिएको सम्बन्धी सूचना
summary: The Nepalese government has proposed an amendment to the Passport Act, 2076, which aims to simplify the process of obtaining a passport and make it more efficient. The amendment also includes provisions for temporary passports and special passports for government officials and dignitaries.

title: Press Release: Third Meeting of Nepal–Denmark Bilateral Consultations
summary: Nepal and Denmark held their third bilateral consultation meeting in Kathmandu on 16 June 2026, reviewing their relations since 1967 and agreeing to celebrate the 60th anniversary of diplomatic relations in 2027. The talks covered cooperation in clean energy, trade, investment, tourism, IT and digital innovation, as well as climate change and the SDGs. Both sides expressed confidence that their newly formed governments would give fresh impetus to bilateral ties.

title: प्रेस विज्ञप्ति (२०८२।१२।१६)
summary: The Ministry of Education, Science and Technology has issued a press release directing all institutions to stop running entrance preparation classes and bridge courses for school-level admissions from Baisakh 1, 2083, citing negative impacts on equitable access to education and unnecessary financial burden on students. It also instructs that higher education programs not operating under existing laws be closed, and requests district administration offices to monitor compliance and proceed with legal action.

title: प्रेस विज्ञप्ति- काभ्रे दुर्घटना
summary: A bus accident in Kavrepalanchok district killed 8 people and injured 16, the government has expressed condolences and ordered an investigation into the cause of the accident. The injured are being treated at a local hospital. The government has also directed relevant agencies to provide effective treatment and support to the affected families.

title: Press Release- Return of the Rt. Hon. Vice President from Qatar
summary: Vice President Ramsahay Prasad Yadav returned to Nepal on 16 July 2026 after a three-day official visit to Qatar. During the visit, he met Qatar's Amir at Lusail Palace, delivered a condolence letter from Nepal's President on the passing of the Father Amir, and expressed Nepal's condolences on behalf of the government and people.

title: Press Release: Tragic Accident Involving Nepali Climbers on Broad Peak
summary: A tragic accident occurred on Broad Peak, resulting in the death of several Nepali climbers, including renowned mountaineer Nirmal Purja. The incident happened on July 30, 2026, at an altitude of 6,600 meters. The Nepali government has expressed condolences to the families of the deceased climbers.

title: Press Release-Nepali Climbers on Mt. Broad Peak
summary: Nepal's Ministry of Foreign Affairs is monitoring the situation after an avalanche on Mt. Broad Peak and is coordinating with Pakistani authorities and the Alpine Club of Pakistan to rescue affected climbers. The expedition team, led by Nirmal Purja 'Nims Dai', includes Nepali climbers and climbers from Oman, Pakistan, China, and the USA. Pakistan has assured Nepal that all available resources will be mobilized for timely search and rescue operations.

title: पुराना सवारी साधन र अन्य सामान लिलाम बढाबढ बिक्रीसम्बन्धी बोलपत्र आह्वानको सूचना
summary: This notice invites bids for the auction sale of old vehicles and other goods. It was published on 29 Bhadra 2077 (Nepali calendar) and serves as a public invitation for interested parties to participate in the bidding process.

title: Vacancy & Career
summary: Kathmandu University has announced various vacancies and career opportunities, including student assistantships, intern research assistants, and lecturer positions. The university is also accepting applications for an Exam Officer on a contractual basis. Interested candidates can apply through the university's website. The vacancies are available in different departments, including Computer Science and Engineering, Mathematics, and Health Informatics.

title: स्वास्थ्यकर्मी तथा स्वास्थ्य संस्था सुरक्षाको दर्ता फारम (Google Form)
summary: The notice provides two Google Forms for registering health institutions and health workers as part of a safety registration initiative. Health institutions and health workers can use the provided links to complete their registration. The notice is dated 13 Falgun 2081.

title: High School (KUHS)
summary: This page is the navigation menu for the KUHS High School website, providing links to sections such as About, Admission, Academics, Student Life, News, Notices, Resources, and Contact. It serves as a general entry point for visitors seeking school information.

title: Department
summary: Kathmandu University has announced that admissions are open for the August 2026 intake, inviting applications across its various schools and departments. The page also serves as a directory listing departments organized by school, including Arts, Education, Engineering, Law, Management, Medical Sciences, and Science.

title: सार्वजनिक खरिद पुनरावलोकन समितिको रिक्त अध्यक्ष र सदस्य पदमा दरखास्तका लागि अनुसूची-१ र अनुसूची-२ बमोजिमको आवेदन फारामको ढाँचा।
summary: The Government of Nepal, through the Office of the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers, is inviting applications to fill the vacant positions of Chairperson (1) and Members (2) of the Public Procurement Review Committee. Eligible candidates must submit their applications within 7 days of the notice's publication date (2083/02/29) to the Public Procurement Monitoring Office in Kathmandu, using the prescribed forms. The Council of Ministers will make the final appointment based on a shortlist prepared by the office.

title: Travel Advisory-Iran
summary: The Nepalese government advises citizens to defer travel plans to Iran due to unfolding developments and recommends those already in Iran to leave at the earliest opportunity. Citizens are also requested to prepare travel documents for emergency exit. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Embassy of Nepal in Doha are available for coordination.

title: Press Release- Minister for Foreign Affairs held a Virtual Meeting with the UK Secretary of State for Defence on Outstanding British Gurkha Issues
summary: Nepal's Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal held a virtual meeting with UK Defence Secretary Dan Jarvis to discuss unresolved grievances of British Gurkhas. Khanal urged the UK to address the issues with compassion and recognition of the Gurkhas' sacrifice, while Jarvis said resolving the issue is a priority for the UK government. The meeting was coordinated by the British Embassy in Kathmandu.

title: Fourth Meeting of the Nepal-Canada Bilateral Consultation Mechanism
summary: The Fourth Meeting of the Nepal-Canada Bilateral Consultation Mechanism concluded in Kathmandu, reviewing bilateral relations and expressing satisfaction over the longstanding friendship and cooperation between the two countries. The meeting covered various areas of mutual interest, including trade, investment, climate change, and education. Both sides reaffirmed their commitment to working together to address shared global challenges.

title: Library
summary: Kathmandu University's Central Library plays a crucial role in the institution, providing information and resources for students, faculty, and research. The library has a large collection of books, journals, and digital resources, and is open from 7am to 8pm on weekdays. The library has rules and regulations in place for borrowing and using materials.

title: Timeline (Work in Progress)
summary: Kathmandu University has released a notice about its recent developments, including new academic programs, inauguration of various centers and buildings, and collaborations with international institutions. The university has also been honored for its contributions to education and research. The notice provides an overview of the university's progress and achievements.

title: प्रेस विज्ञप्ति (२०८२।०४।१३)
summary: The Ministry of Education, Science and Technology announced a courtesy meeting between Education Minister Raghuji Pant and South Korean Ambassador Park Taeyong. Both sides discussed strengthening education cooperation, the resumption of NOC issuance for Nepali students going to Korea, and collaboration in vocational training and higher education. The minister also shared plans for an educational diplomacy framework and a database of Nepalis working or studying in Korea.

title: परराष्ट्र मन्त्रालयको एक सय दिनको कार्यसम्पादन
summary: The Nepalese Ministry of Foreign Affairs has released its 100-day performance report, highlighting key achievements in areas such as consular services, rescue of Nepalis from online scams, and diplomatic efforts with countries like India and China.

title: शैक्षिक परामर्श सेवा तथा भाषा शिक्षणसम्बन्धी निर्देशिका, २०७३ खारेजीसम्बन्धी सूचना
summary: The Ministry of Education has repealed its Directive 2073 on educational counseling services and language teaching. The repeal was made by a minister-level decision after the new Regulation 2083 governing these services was gazetted and came into effect. The notice informs all concerned parties accordingly.

title: सम्पत्ति विवरण सार्वजनिक गरिएको सम्बन्धी प्रेस विज्ञप्ति
summary: The Prime Minister and ministers of Nepal have submitted their asset declarations under Section 50 of the Anti-Corruption Act, 2059, and the government has now made these declarations public. The asset details can be viewed on the official website of the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers Office at opmem.gov.np.

title: BIMSTEC DAY MESSAGES BY THE RT. HON. PRIME MINISTER AND THE HON. FOREIGN MINISTER
summary: Nepal's Prime Minister and Foreign Minister sent messages on BIMSTEC's 29th anniversary, highlighting regional cooperation and connectivity. They emphasized the importance of promoting tourism, youth opportunities, and resilience against climate change. Nepal reaffirmed its commitment to a connected and prosperous BIMSTEC region.

title: Fee Structure
summary: Kathmandu University has published the tuition fee structures for all schools for the fiscal years 2078/79, 2079/80, 2081/82, and 2082/83. The fee documents are available as PDF downloads on the university's website. Current and prospective students can refer to these fee schedules for their respective programs.

title: Concluding Remarks by Hon. Mr Shisir Khanal Minister for Foreign Affairs at the Fifth Edition of the Professor Yadu Nath Khanal Lecture Series
summary: Hon. Mr Shisir Khanal, Minister for Foreign Affairs, delivered concluding remarks at the Fifth Edition of the Professor Yadu Nath Khanal Lecture Series, emphasizing the importance of informed public discussion on foreign policy and diplomacy. He highlighted the need for Nepal's foreign policy to adapt to evolving realities while remaining firmly anchored in national interest. The lecture series aimed to encourage thoughtful deliberations on Nepal's foreign policy and its challenges in a changing world.

title: सरसफाइ सेवा खरिद सम्बन्धी सूचना
summary: The Office of the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers has issued an invitation for bids to procure sanitary (cleaning) services through national competitive bidding. Interested bidders must submit electronic bids via the PPMO e-GP system by August 24, 2026, with a bid security of at least NPR 90,000. A pre-bid meeting will be held on August 14, 2026.

title: Press Release- Hon. Minister for Foreign Affairs to Pay an Official Visit to the People’s Republic of China
summary: Nepal's Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal is making an official visit to China from 14 to 17 June 2026 at the invitation of Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi. He will hold bilateral talks in Beijing, attend an investment conference to promote foreign investment in Nepal, and interact with the Nepali community. The visit aims to strengthen Nepal-China relations and deepen cooperation.

title: दरखास्त स्वीकृतसम्बन्धी सूचना
summary: This is a public notice regarding the acceptance of applications. It lists applicants whose applications have been approved, likely for a government program or position. The notice provides a table of names and related details for reference.

title: जानकारी तथा ध्यानाकर्षण गराइएको बारे ।
summary: The Ministry of Education, Science and Technology has warned teachers and staff against engaging in political activities, citing laws that prohibit such actions and threatening disciplinary action. The ministry has also decided not to recognize teacher unions affiliated with political parties. The ministry emphasizes its commitment to protecting the professional rights and interests of teachers and staff.

title: प्रेस विज्ञप्ति (२०८२।१२।२५)
summary: The Ministry of Education has directed schools to refund excess fees collected from students, warning of further action if they fail to comply. Some schools have been found to be charging fees in excess of the approved standards. A help desk has been set up to handle complaints and grievances related to student fees.

title: Exchange of Congratulatory Messages between the Foreign Ministers of Nepal and the Russian Federation
summary: Nepal and the Russian Federation exchanged congratulatory messages on the 70th anniversary of establishing diplomatic relations. The foreign ministers of both countries expressed willingness to strengthen and broaden bilateral engagements. The diplomatic relations were established on 20 July 1956.

title: School of Arts
summary: The School of Arts website is temporarily offline for maintenance. Visitors can still reach the team by email at admin@entirelyonlineservice.com, and the site is expected to be back up soon.

title: युएईमा उच्च शिक्षा अध्ययन सम्बन्धमा सूचना
summary: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Nepal has issued a public notice warning students about higher education in the UAE, especially institutions in Free Zones. Complaints include unaccredited institutions, lack of proper facilities, irregular online classes, and unfulfilled job promises. Students are advised to verify institutions and obtain a No Objection Letter from the Ministry of Education before going.

title: प्रेस विज्ञप्ती २०८२।१२।२२
summary: Nepal's Ministry of Education has warned institutional schools against enrolling students and charging heavy fees before the 2083 academic session begins. Citing the Education Regulations, a Supreme Court order, and existing fee guidelines, it says fees collected illegally must be refunded to guardians. The Ministry has asked local levels to enforce this and warned that non-compliant schools may face legal action under the Education Act.

title: Statement by Rt. Hon. President Mrs. Bidya Devi Bhandari as Guest of Honour on the theme of “Nepal-Bangladesh Relations and Bangabandhu’s Birth Centenary”
summary: In a statement delivered in Dhaka on 22 March 2021, Nepal's President Bidya Devi Bhandari spoke at an event marking the birth centenary of Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman. She highlighted the close Nepal-Bangladesh ties and called for expanding cooperation in trade, energy, connectivity, tourism, and education, while also stressing joint action on climate change. She noted Nepal's goal of becoming a prosperous middle-income country.

title: प्रेस विज्ञप्ती २०८२।१२।१९
summary: The Nepalese government has announced the establishment of autism-based model schools in all seven provinces to support children with autism. The program aims to provide quality education and services to children with autism. The Ministry of Education, Science, and Technology, and the Ministry of Health and Population will work together to implement the program.

title: प्रेस विज्ञप्ति (२०८३।०२।२८)
summary: The Nepalese government's Ministry of Education celebrated International Sports Day on June 11, emphasizing the importance of sports for children's development. The ministry calls for safe and inclusive playgrounds in all schools and promotion of regular sports activities. The government is committed to ensuring equal access to sports for children with disabilities and promoting child protection and social unity through sports.

title: JDS Scholarship for intake 2026 सम्बन्धमा ।
summary: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is hosting a webinar for interested employees about the JDS Scholarship for Intake 2026. The webinar will be held on October 9, 2025. Eligible employees can register on the scholarship website.
